missions.name: Multi-purpose Fiberboard
missions.text: While metals are indispensable in our quest to explore the cosmos, other materials common to Etheirys are no less vital; leather, cloth, and wood all find use in various essential items such as uniforms and furnishings. To ensure the quality of finished products, we have established exacting specifications for base components we require in quantity, and ask that they be prepared to that standard.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of items with limited supplies.
High-quality items will earn a higher score.

missions.name: Fieldwork Fuel
missions.text: Reports are on the rise of supplies being in shortage at remote work sites. While such occurrences are not critical while our operations are limited to Sinus Ardorum, it could be a matter of life and death when we eventually venture to distant stars. To that end, we are redoubling our efforts to maintain our stockpiles, and kindly ask for contributions of essential items such as medical equipment and heating fuel.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of items with limited supplies.
High-quality items will earn a higher score.

missions.name: Gathering Miscellany
missions.text: As the final step in determining the viability of materials sourced here in Sinus Ardorum, we must put them to the proof in actual products. These materials have already been confirmed safe, and we now ask our artisans to use them to produce prototypes of items such as tools and clothing. Should these meet our stringent standards, we will move to employ the materials widely in the initiative.

objectives.text:

missions.name: Multi-purpose Plating
missions.text: Sinus Ardorum is in dire need of materials to support the construction and development of the Moongate Hub, an intrastellar transportation system, on-site domiciles, and infrastructure necessary for travel to other stars. Of these materials, metal plating is some of the highest in demand, specifically that which meets the strict regulations of cosmic exploration. We seek talented crafters capable of fulfilling our metallurgical needs.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of items with limited supplies.
High-quality items will earn a higher score.

missions.name: Spare Starship Parts
missions.text: The new starship we have under construction is the lynchpin of our plans to explore the cosmos. We require artisans to manufacture the hard alloy that will serve as the primary element of its exterior cladding, as well as creating a surplus for repair purposes. As a vessel destined to navigate stellar currents, it must be sturdy enough to withstand the most turbulent aether fluctuations, and the resilient alloy you provide will be further processed into hull plating and other parts as dictated by the starship's unique specifications.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of items with limited supplies.
High-quality items will earn a higher score.

missions.name: Alloy Inspection
missions.text: Lunar adamantite is a mineral unique to the moon, but it seems that the samples collected within Sinus Ardorum exhibit even greater durability than what we've encountered thus far─a property that could prove extremely useful in the construction of starships and various other moon-based facilities. We call upon skilled metalworkers to forge a steady supply of ingots from our stockpiled ore that we might explore and develop new applications for use in our cosmic initiative.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of items with limited supplies.
High-quality items will earn a higher score.

missions.name: Custom Parts (Simple)
missions.text: Whether it be on the moon or another star we've yet to explore, our future ground-based expeditions are certain to encounter impassable terrain. Drones have proven useful for transporting supplies, but we are also looking to modify them to perform detailed aerial surveys in regions which challenge our surface vehicles. We encourage artisans to submit a range of parts that we might customize our drones and expand their practical functionality.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of items with limited supplies.
High-quality items will earn a higher score.

missions.name: Multi-purpose Metal Components
missions.text: The Cosmic Exploration Initiative employs a wide range of machinery, but supplying individually tailored parts for the maintenance of each device on-site would lead to astronomical operation costs. To alleviate this expense, we've imposed a “cosmic standard” on all basic components used in our equipment. Recent reports cite an alarming shortage of the joints and shafts needed to keep the facilities running, and we are welcoming all contributions forged to the aforementioned specifications.

missions.name: Insulated Equipment
missions.text: Several of our new Etheirys colleagues have lodged complaints concerning Sinus Ardorum's “cold,” “dark,” and “impractical” working conditions. While we are unable to address every source of dissatisfaction, requests for improvement are taken very seriously as we strive to provide the most comfortable environment possible. missions.name: Rover Shafts
missions.text: The Cosmic Exploration Initiative employs a wide range of machinery, but supplying individually tailored parts for the maintenance of each device on-site would lead to astronomical operation costs. We seek skilled artisans to test refine the raw materials to determine whether they can be a viable resource for the initiative.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of collectables with limited time and supplies.
Collectability will be scored.

missions.name: EX: Replica Incensories
missions.text: As appears to be characteristic of Sharlayan itself, the initiative has been welcoming new members from all corners of Etheirys. Thus, when it comes to devising a comforting “home away from home” environment for this eclectic cohort, simply borrowing elements from any singular culture will not suffice. We request all veteran artisans to submit recreations of Etheirys furnishings that we might build a broad selection of regional styles.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of collectables without failing once within the time limit.
Collectability will be scored.

missions.name: EX: Fine-grade Material Processing
missions.text: For our next round of testing, we'd like to ascertain the degree of precision crafting that can be attained using the moon's native materials. Replicating Etheirys's engineered goods will provide us an initial reference point, but we are hopeful that the lessons learned during this process will be applicable to future initiative projects. Ideally, these parts will be used to improve Moongate Hub facilities, so contributing artisans should concentrate on demonstrating fine detail while also preserving the necessary function.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of collectables with limited time and supplies.
Collectability will be scored.

missions.name: EX: Moongate Hub Equipment
missions.text: Although the moon is bathed in the same sunlight and starlight as Etheirys, the lack of atmosphere to scatter this light makes for dark skies and darker shadows. In order to maintain a properly lit working environment throughout our facilities, we request that all available artisans turn their hands to the manufacture of specified illumination devices.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of collectables with limited time and supplies.
Collectability will be scored.

missions.name: EX: Workspace Lighting
missions.text: Several of our new Etheirys colleagues have lodged complaints concerning Sinus Ardorum's “cold,” “dark,” and “impractical” working conditions. While we are unable to address every source of dissatisfaction, requests for improvement are taken very seriously as we strive to provide the most comfortable environment possible. Qualified artisans are encouraged to participate in this endeavor through the manufacture of optimized tools and equipment.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of collectables without failing once within the time limit.
Collectability will be scored.

missions.name: EX+: High-durability Material Processing
missions.text: Expeditions into the lunar nadir have detected promising sources of liquid and gaseous fuels which, when properly researched and developed, will prove highly valuable in future initiative applications. To that end, we request the construction of the tanks and containers necessary for safely storing and transporting these resources to the Moongate Hub.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of items with limited time and supplies.
High-quality items will earn a higher score.

missions.name: EX+: Impact-resistant Material Processing
missions.text: Interior construction in the Moongate Hub employs the basic materials recommended by our current guidelines. It is problematic, however, to assume that this same standard of structural integrity will suffice once the initiative progresses to unknown─and potentially less hospitable─reaches of the cosmos. We hope to preemptively solve this issue by refitting facilities with materials of greater durability, and request skilled artisans to manufacture replacement partitions and other interior components from sturdy metals.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of items with limited time and supplies.
High-quality items will earn a higher score.

missions.text: As the initiative progresses, the scale of inventory management, not to mention the number of people taking up residence on base, continues to expand at a rapid pace. In the case of bulky or complex items, we request that artisans report to us at each stage of the production process.

As a vessel destined to navigate stellar currents, it must be sturdy enough to withstand the most turbulent aether fluctuations, and the resilient alloy you provide will be further processed into hull plating and other parts as dictated by the starship's unique specifications.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of collectables with limited time and supplies.
Collectability will be scored.

missions.name: High-performance Drone Materials I
missions.text: Whether it be on the moon or another star we've yet to explore, our future ground-based expeditions are certain to encounter impassable terrain. Drones have proven useful for transporting supplies, but we are also looking to modify them to perform detailed aerial surveys in regions which challenge our surface vehicles. We encourage artisans to submit a range of parts that we might customize our drones and expand their practical functionality.

To determine whether this secretion is fit for consumption, the fluid must be processed into an edible form. While the organism in question may be only an anomalous mutation, we believe it has great potential, and recommend processing it into food products or alchemical mixtures.

missions.name: Worker's Banquet Preparation I
missions.text: The initiative has decided to treat our workers to warm meals and fatigue-relieving medicine as a reward for their efforts. Considering our numbers, such an undertaking is no small feat, and requires the preparation of large quantities of product that maintains uniform quality in both effectiveness and flavor. Due to the complexity of the task, we ask that our artisans report to us for evaluation periodically during the course of their work.

missions.name: Loporrit Dietary Improvement I
missions.text: While Hydaelyn has blessed us Loporrits with an industriousness that can endure countless centuries, we are still driven by our spirits, and as such our performance fluctuates in relation to our mental well-being. To keep morale high, we request items that will enhance the mood of Loporrit workers. Just as people from Etheirys find comfort in verdant greens and soothing blues, we take solace in ashen greys that remind us of the moon─and of course, anything that tastes like carrots is a delicacy to our palates.

missions.text: For the preservation and study of aquatic resources, development of vessels which recreate their natural environment is crucial. missions.name: EX: Soothing Censers
missions.text: Unlike Mare Lamentorum, where structures wrought by Hydaelyn yet stand, Sinus Ardorum bears no trace of Etheirys's civilization. It makes a Loporrit wonder: can materials procured from this forlorn place be crafted into items which provide warmth and comfort to people's lives? It is with this query in mind that contributors are requested to utilize lunar resources in the recreation of furnishings seen on Etheirys. Once the finished product's safety is confirmed, we shall invite initiative members to review the utility of such items in their capacity as a reminder of home.

missions.name: EX+: Automaton Digging

This shall be an exercise not only of practical use to our future interstellar endeavors, but a scientific inquiry into what manner of tools contributors can craft from lunar resources.

missions.name: Kindling
missions.text: The sporing mist has given rise to highly toxic mutant spongoi in the southern sector of Weddingway's Bower. Their spores can adhere to nearby workers, plants, and ships, and immediate eradication is necessary to prevent adverse effects. Workers are already burning the spongoi away with flamethrowers, but they face a shortage of fuel, flame-resistant cloth, and protective gear. We require skilled artisans to prepare these materials and deliver them with the utmost haste.

missions.name: Fungal Building Materials
missions.text: It appears Weddingway's Bower is home to a form of beneficial spongos, which can be found to the east of the blooming beds. With robust and viscous mycelium, we believe it can be processed into durable fabric suited for interstellar exploration or converted into hard, lightweight construction materials that can adapt to varied environments. Since the spongoi must be processed immediately after collection, we are putting out an urgent call for skilled artisans. We look forward to your valuable contribution to the initiative.

missions.text: A shower of small meteorites was detected to the southwest of the Moongate Hub, and the objects have become obstructions to various activities in the area. While prompt removal of the meteorites is necessary, we believe some may contain rare and valuable metals, which we hope to extract and utilize as resources. Our teams have already begun breaking down the fallen objects, but they report a shortage of spare tools. We request the swift delivery of said tools and the retrieval of valuable meteorites from the area.

We are currently working to remove the accumulated gas, but the high volume of the substance has caused a shortage of necessary equipment and gear, which we ask our artisans to deliver directly.

Reports indicate that vegetation and life in the northeastern sector of the Cosmoor have been affected. While no harmful toxins or similar abnormalities have been detected, we cannot rule out the presence of harmful mutations. We ask that any capable hands travel to the Cosmoor and investigate the effects of the sporing mist, then collect biological samples for further analysis.

missions.name: Multi-purpose Glass
missions.text: Phaenna is home to a wealth of glass from which we have successfully refined a variety of construction materials and scientific samples, going as far as to establish our own standards to meet our exacting specifications. Speaking of exacting specifications, we are seeking contributors to supply sufficient quantities of high-purity glass fiber. The resulting materials will be used in the transmission cables that run between Glassblowers' Beacon and our other facilities.

missions.name: Resource Experimentation I
missions.text: We are presently pondering how the inorganic flora and impesctors found across Phaenna might be utilized for the initiative. Contributors are hence requested to fabricate as many components of varying insulative properties as able.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of items with limited supplies.
High-quality items will earn a higher score.

missions.name: Bathing Equipment
missions.text: When annealing winds arrive and the entire region grows frigid, it's cold enough to make even a Loporrit's fur stand on end. It is therefore all the more necessary for our fur-deprived─and even abundantly furred!─contributors to warm themselves adequately after tending to a red alert. One and all under our watch must be both warm and snug, and so we request the fabrication of heaters and bathing equipment. We desire a vast enough yield to ensure no soul is deprived of warmth when they most need it.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of collectables with limited supplies.
Collectability will be scored.

missions.name: Experimental Stormproof Components
missions.text: Though we persist in our efforts to maintain an ideal environment via rainbow crystals, the dense aether clouds permeating Phaenna's skies are nevertheless known to trigger various weather phenomena. Lightning strikes in particular can have catastrophic effects, and thus we seek to install additional lightning rods in the exploration zone. Contributors are requested to deliver the requisite components to aid us in achieving that goal.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of items with limited supplies.
High-quality items will earn a higher score.

missions.name: Large Kitchen Equipment
missions.text: Although we brought a variety of instruments with us to Phaenna, the unique challenges posed by resource collection and refinement here on the star necessitate more appropriate tools. To meet demand, we are asking contributors to produce a range of specialist equipment. Although some might question the decision to focus on tools suited only to specific tasks, we deem the consequent boost to productivity more than worth the effort.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of items with limited supplies.
High-quality items will earn a higher score.

missions.name: Phaenna Glass Resupply
missions.text: Phaenna is a treasure trove of glass resources. The initiative has established its own set of standards for the refinement of these valuable materials, with the intention of sending samples back to Sinus Ardorum for use in the construction of facilities and in the pursuit of interstellar research. Contributors are requested to produce quality glass ingots in bulk as we determine the potential applications of this star's abounding resource.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of items with limited supplies.
High-quality items will earn a higher score.

missions.name: Planetary Ore Refinement
missions.text: While this star is home to a prodigious amount of glass, rare minerals have been found within cluster formations on occasion. Were we to succeed in extracting metallic resources from them, the glass itself may become a vein of precious metals for the initiative. As such, we ask that contributors attempt to extract metals from a selection of glass clusters and render them into nuggets and ingots accordingly.

objectives.text:
Craft items with limited time and supplies and achieve the target score.
High-quality items will earn a higher score.
※Mission cannot be completed with only normal-quality items.

missions.name: Precision Component Processing
missions.text: Included among the supplies sent from Sinus Ardorum are unprocessed materials, which we hope to refine for various purposes. Contributors are requested to process these raw materials to produce components for the Cosmoliner, and ensure the initiative has a stockpile of necessary resources at all times.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of collectables with limited supplies.
Collectability will be scored.

missions.name: Crafter's Tools
missions.text: Although we brought a variety of instruments with us to Phaenna, the unique challenges posed by resource collection and refinement here on the star necessitate more appropriate tools. To meet demand, we are asking contributors to produce a range of specialist equipment. Although some might question the decision to focus on tools suited only to specific tasks, we deem the consequent boost to productivity more than worth the effort.

objectives.text:

Collectability will be scored.

missions.name: Experimental Alloy Samples
missions.text: A diverse variety of minerals can be found on Phaenna, many of which exhibit a distinctive color. Though difficult to utilize in isolation, refining the minerals with a multitude of metals could produce alloys suitable for our needs. With the aim of widening our pool of resources on this star, we ask that contributors smelt alloy samples for experimental purposes.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of collectables with limited supplies.
Collectability will be scored.

missions.name: EX: Artisanal Craftwork
missions.text: Advancements are regularly being made with the practical use of glass resources found here. Thus far, local glass has been utilized in the production of lens for delicate equipment such as drones and the Stellascope, but with the proper processing expertise, we believe the glass may even be fashioned into materials for artistic craftworks. Capable contributors are requested to fashion high-quality products fitting this description as a demonstration of this potential application.

objectives.text:
Craft collectables with limited supplies and achieve the target score.
Collectability will be scored.

missions.name: EX: Glass Furnace Assembly II
missions.text: Furnaces are required for the refinement of glass, yet due to the equipment's considerable size, it cannot be transported here from Sinus Ardorum. As our present inventory is insufficient, it falls to our talented contributors to locally assemble the remainder that we need. As we will provide the requisite materials for production, we ask only that our artisans produce furnaces according to the needs of each section.

objectives.text:

missions.name: EX+: Battery Packs
missions.text: The mini rovers have been a great boon to project efforts around the star. Unfortunately, the vehicles rapidly deplete battery packs, and we now find our reserves running low. Contributors are urged to produce as many battery packs as possible, that we may replenish our stock and have extra on hand in case of emergencies.

objectives.text:
Craft collectables with limited time and supplies and achieve the target score.
Collectability will be scored.

missions.name: Glassworker's Tools I
missions.text: Refinement of local resources is ongoing at the base, as our teams learn from distinguished glasswork experts from Etheirys. Unfortunately, we presently lack much of the requisite specialist equipment for this work, and request the procurement of a variety of tools for glassworking. Due to the complexity of this task, we ask that our artisans report to us for evaluation periodically during the course of their work.

missions.name: EX: Operation Chilling-a-Way Drone Parts I

missions.name: Stellascope Parts I
missions.text: The Cosmic Exploration Initiative intends to launch its exploration into deeper, unknown regions of space from this star─but not without first getting a wider glimpse of what's out there through the Stellascope. It is therefore imperative that we secure sufficient supplies for its continued construction and future maintenance. The Stellascope is the product of our combined knowledge of the cosmos and study of aetherology, and could theoretically give us insight into the flow of aether in distant galaxies. To meet the scope's exacting needs, we request highly aetheroconductive parts of the finest quality from contributors.

We require additional components to upgrade further drones to our current standard.

objectives.text:

missions.name: Stellascope Parts I
missions.text: The Cosmic Exploration Initiative intends to launch its exploration into deeper, unknown regions of space from this star─but not without first getting a wider glimpse of what's out there through the Stellascope. It is therefore imperative that we secure sufficient supplies for its continued construction and future maintenance. The Stellascope is the product of our combined knowledge of the cosmos and study of aetherology, and could theoretically give us insight into the flow of aether in distant galaxies. To meet the scope's exacting needs, we request highly aetheroconductive parts of the finest quality from contributors.

objectives.text:

missions.name: Multi-purpose Glass

missions.name: Glass Resource Refinement
missions.text: While this star is home to a prodigious amount of glass, rare minerals have been found within cluster formations on occasion. Were we to succeed in extracting metallic resources from them, the glass itself may become a vein of precious metals for the initiative. As such, we ask that contributors attempt to extract metals from a selection of glass clusters and render them into nuggets and ingots accordingly.

missions.name: Drone Lenses

missions.text: When annealing winds arrive and the entire region grows frigid, it's cold enough to make even a Loporrit's fur stand on end. One and all under our watch must be both warm and snug, and so we request the fabrication of heaters and bathing equipment. We desire a vast enough yield to ensure no soul is deprived of warmth when they most need it.

missions.name: Improved Tents
missions.text: Phaenna's extreme weather conditions and unique atmospheric composition represent serious challenges to material preservation. Our aim is to develop an innovative, highly functional tent to help better protect the stockpiles essential to our ongoing success. To this end, we request contributors to craft components for use in initial prototypes.

missions.name: Resource Experimentation I
missions.text: We are presently pondering how the inorganic flora and impesctors found across Phaenna might be utilized for the initiative. Given the practical limitations of sourcing supplies from the moon, finding a means of transforming these phenomena into viable materials is of utmost concern. As part of this experimentation drive, we ask that contributors help craft the materials we seek.

missions.name: Recycled Resource Utilization I
missions.text: It is crucial we avoid squandering even a speck of the precious resources ferried to Phaenna from the moon. This is precisely why we are hoping to improve our rates of recycling and utilization of reclaimed materials. Certain supplies, including fuel, clothing, and even stationery, are especially well suited to the task. We call upon contributors to show their commitment to sustainability and craft the required items with the resources provided.

missions.name: Camping Tents
missions.text: As we range ever further across the star, many of our contributors are choosing to sleep on-site when working away from the base. We therefore request the manufacture of supplies to ensure our brave outdoor sleepers can do so in the comfort they deserve.

missions.name: EX+: Temporary Collection Points
missions.text: Though the Cosmoliner's construction is sure to improve efficiency across the board, it cannot cover the entire breadth of the region, and so we seek components for portable storage facilities to use as strategic relay points. Please include with each submission a roof to shield against inclement weather and a sturdy floor to support the weight of the storage containers to be held therein.

missions.name: EX+: High-performance Bedding
missions.text: While Sinus Ardorum's close proximity to Etheirys instilled a sense of comfort and reassurance among many of our contributors, life on distant Phaenna is proving less amenable to some. Indeed, as we explore this vitreous, inhospitable planet, creature comforts will have an outsized impact on well-being and morale. We therefore request the provision of sumptuous bedding for use in our habitation modules. After all, what could provide greater comfort than knowing one's bedclothes were crafted with care by a fellow contributor?

missions.name: Seasoned Archon Loaf I
missions.text: Given that so little of Phaenna is edible, we took it upon ourselves to import a large quantity of Archon loaf for the Beacon. To our great distress, however, a majority of non-Sharlayan crew members have now submitted formal complaints about the taste! Thus, at great personal sacrifice do we Loporrits hereby offer unfettered access to our precious supply of carrots... Please, artisans, use them however you must to create a mouthwatering condiment for this bread.

missions.name: Emergency Rations
missions.text: The food supply is an ongoing concern partially solved by our aggressive foray into aquaculture, but we are as of yet almost entirely reliant on shipments from Sinus Ardorum. Naturally, it would be foolish to presume the *Galactic Way* will always operate in perfect condition. Therefore, in the interest of crisis prevention, we seek to establish a stockpile of provisions as a countermeasure. For this request, artisans are asked to prioritize nutrition above all else, even flavor.

missions.name: EX+: Stable Dairy Storage
missions.text: Demand has risen among Sharlayan contributors for a palatable taste of home, so we have imported a small supply of a particular dairy dish. Its fermentation ensures that it lasts at least a few days, but some have hypothesized that condensing it into a confection will not only prolong its freshness, but enhance its nutritional value. We request that artisans skilled in culinary and medicinal fields assist us by both creating and condensing this fermented dairy product. Should it prove to be a viable supplement, we will consider larger imports in the future.

missions.text: The cultivation of crops imported from the moon and the selective breeding of Phaenna's unique flora continues apace at Glassblowers' Beacon. This task will require patience and an eye for detail, so we request the assistance of highly skilled artisans.

missions.name: Morale Maintenance I
missions.text: The only thing more puzzling than the workers' insistence on using pen and paper despite having the latest exotablets is their fondness for cooking with needlessly convoluted recipes rather than partaking in our nigh-limitless supply of Archon loaf. Customs that, perhaps, remind them of home. Or so we believe. As these practices seem to enhance rather than hinder their performance, we see no harm in accomodating them. To that end, we ask that our artisans fashion suitable writing and cooking utensils.

This is an urgent request for supplies, including dust-collection tools, dust-filtering masks, and vessels to store the gathered dust. Deliveries should be made directly to the site of the incident.

objectives.text:

High-quality items will earn a higher score.
Deliver items to the designated location.

missions.name: Repair Cloth
missions.text: A mini rover to the south of Glassblowers' Beacon has been struck by lightning and rendered inoperative. With the entrance to the Glassblown Grotto only a stone's throw away, it poses a potential obstruction to operations, and must be restored to working condition as soon as possible. Our engineers are currently tending to the rover, but they lack a number of crucial parts. This is an urgent request for the required resources to be delivered directly to the repair site.

missions.name: Hanging Tool Pouches
missions.text: A severe thunderstorm is unfolding to the southwest of Glassblowers' Beacon, with lightning strikes threatening to take down the whole Cosmoliner network. Though dangerous, we have no choice but to proceed with the installation of temporary lightning rods on nearby elevated ground. We urgently call for deliveries of the required materials directly to Millefiori, and additionally request cooperation in clearing the path to the hilltop of obstructing flora.

missions.text: We have received an urgent communication from the mobilization station. If left unchecked, the dust fuses to everything it touches due to the ambient heat, so haste is of the essence. The materials required for the task are in short supply, and those answering the call are asked to proceed directly to the mobilization station with dust-collection tools and protective coating for equipment.

As such, we are issuing an urgent request for these resources to be supplemented. A temporary repository has been established on the east side of Glassblowers' Beacon. All supplies are to be delivered posthaste to this location.

To that end, we are issuing a request for the timely delivery of lightning-rod parts to harness the lightning strikes, and batteries to store the gathered power. Once we obtain data on the utilization of this energy, a fearsome force will become a blessing from the heavens!

We request the urgent supply of new parts and lightning-resistant oil required to complete repairs on any sections exhibiting problems.

missions.name: Water Quality Inspection Samples
missions.text: Being isolated from the surface, Capsule Chasm is a unique environment on Phaenna and home to many an intriguing phenomenon. Glass dust is prone to accumulating in the area, and the arrival of the glass rain provides us with the perfect opportunity to conduct further research into the impact that chasm conditions have on aquatic life and impesctors. We ask for assistance in preparing the water collected on-site into samples for our researchers, as well as in the procurement of impesctors.

missions.text: Many of us have experienced the stomach-churning turbulence that sometimes befalls the *Galactic Way* during its landing sequence on Oizys. Although this is merely the influence of the star's gravitational anomalies, and not a fault with the vessel itself, the issue has led to occasional cargo damage. Indeed, some contributors assigned to excavation duties have begun to complain of respiratory ailments. We wish to remedy the issue before it spirals out of control, and therefore ask contributors to produce comfortable dust-filtering masks for distribution.

missions.text: Desert Burrow has proven to be far larger than we initially predicted, not to mention filled with archaeological marvels. While our researchers delight in these discoveries, a more pressing concern faces us: severe shortages of excavation equipment. Contributors are called upon to meet the demand for sturdy scaffolding and rugged gloves. These vital supplies will help further accelerate our efforts to uncover relics and learn more of Oizys's past.

missions.text: One of our La Noscean-born contributors submitted a request to make use of the Sound Pole on their days off─a request which we have duly authorized. Although we generally advise against bathing in the waters due to the intense electromagnetism in the sector, the risk posed by short breaks on the beach was deemed minimal. To help enhance the area's natural potential for relaxation, we require artisans to provide a variety of leisure supplies.

objectives.text:

In the absence of biological evidence, the tools and furnishings they once used are the puzzle pieces for solving this mystery, serving to reveal characteristics such as size and physiology. Our researchers wish to recreate such items based on schematics produced with available data, and we seek contributions from artisans who possess the requisite skills and attention to detail.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of collectables with limited time and supplies.
Collectability will be scored.

missions.name: Multi-purpose Fiber
missions.text: The initiative utilizes fiber in many of its machines, with adjustments made in different locations to heighten environmental compatibility. On Oizys, for example, allowances must be made to cope with the star's gravitational anomalies. While we constantly strive to meet the ever-growing demand for fiber, assistance with our production efforts is always appreciated. Contributors are thus called upon to make routine deliveries of this vital material.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of items with limited supplies.
High-quality items will earn a higher score.

missions.name: Resilient Resource Processing I
missions.text: Through recent studies, we have come to understand Oizys's gravitational anomalies as magical phenomena. We must therefore ensure our equipment is protected from aetheric interference, lest we are plagued with malfunctions. Artisans are asked to manufacture the aether-resistant shielding crucial for this endeavor.

objectives.text:

missions.name: Cushioned Packaging Materials
missions.text: Many of us have experienced the stomach-churning turbulence that sometimes befalls the *Galactic Way* during its landing sequence on Oizys. Although this is merely the influence of the star's gravitational anomalies, and not a fault with the vessel itself, the issue has led to occasional cargo damage. To mitigate the problem, we ask contributors to supply lightweight cushioning materials that may then be utilized on the craft.

objectives.text:

High-quality items will earn a higher score.

missions.name: Stabilizing Materials I
missions.text: We have received reports of highly localized gravitational anomalies wreaking havoc, causing unsecured equipment and materials to float into the air. Based on our analysis, the most effective means of combating the issue is to simply weigh affected articles down with heavy objects. However, owing to the anomalies' intensity, standard rope will not suffice when fastening these rudimentary anchors. We thus seek skilled artisans to fabricate exceptionally strong rope fit for the task.

missions.name: EX: Mass-produced Transportation Materials
missions.text: According to reports, the *Galactic Way* was recently caught in a gravitational anomaly when leaving Oizys's atmosphere. The crew were able to quickly regain control of the vessel, but the onboard cargo sadly sustained major damage. Clearly, cushioning alone is insufficient to guarantee safe exports of the star's rare materials. We are therefore seeking artisans to produce a variety of sturdy, expertly crafted materials to secure freight during transit.

objectives.text:
Craft collectables with limited time and supplies and achieve the target score.
Collectability will be scored.

missions.name: EX: Excavation Necessities
missions.text: Here upon Oizys, we are all locked in a protracted battle against dust, but its ill effects are most keenly felt near excavation sites, where much of it is generated. Indeed, some contributors assigned to excavation duties have begun to complain of respiratory ailments. We wish to remedy the issue before it spirals out of control, and therefore ask contributors to produce comfortable dust-filtering masks for distribution.

objectives.text:
Craft collectables with limited supplies and achieve the target score.
Collectability will be scored.

missions.name: EX: Excavation Equipment
missions.text: Desert Burrow has proven to be far larger than we initially predicted, not to mention filled with archaeological marvels. While our researchers delight in these discoveries, a more pressing concern faces us: severe shortages of excavation equipment. Contributors are called upon to meet the demand for sturdy scaffolding and rugged gloves. These vital supplies will help further accelerate our efforts to uncover relics and learn more of Oizys's past.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of collectables with limited supplies.
Collectability will be scored.

missions.name: EX: Beach Break Supplies
missions.text: One of our La Noscean-born contributors submitted a request to make use of the Sound Pole on their days off─a request which we have duly authorized. Although we generally advise against bathing in the waters due to the intense electromagnetism in the sector, the risk posed by short breaks on the beach was deemed minimal. To help enhance the area's natural potential for relaxation, we require artisans to provide a variety of leisure supplies.

objectives.text:
Craft items without failing once.
High-quality items will earn a higher score.

missions.name: EX+: Planetary Resource Utilization
missions.text: With infrastructure expanding apace, we can at last begin to improve living conditions for our hardworking contributors. To support this benevolent endeavor, artisans are requested to fabricate a range of comfortable furnishings. By utilizing local materials in particular, it is hoped we might also gauge the potential of Oizys's natural resources for myriad other applications.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of collectables with limited supplies.
Collectability will be scored.

missions.name: EX+: Organic Material Advanced Processing
missions.text: Although Oizys's mineral wealth is much vaunted, our research teams are also investigating potential uses for the star's vegetation. Having evolved over millennia to thrive despite the ravages of gravitational anomalies, many species harbor promising properties we might utilize. To help further our investigation, contributors are asked to remove impurities from resin and fiber extracted from local flora, and process the resulting materials.

objectives.text:
Craft collectables with limited time and supplies and achieve the target score.
Collectability will be scored.

missions.name: EX+: Star Admiral's Trouser Fabric I
missions.text: We require a number of talented artisans to work with the rare resources unearthed on the star. Those who receive this directive may consider themselves among the initiative's finest contributors─deemed to possess the exceptional skills necessary for such a task. Due to the scarcity of these resources and the challenges inherent in processing them, we will issue a specialized device to assist artisans, but be warned that it has a limited charge.

missions.name: Emergency Water Supply
missions.text: The procurement of potable water is paramount to the initiative's─and, indeed, mankind's─survival. While we expected few water sources on Oizys's desolate landscape, its naturally occurring gravitational anomalies have presented us with a pleasant surprise: the discovery of a floating, spherical water source. Though its contents must be cleansed of some impurities, we believe that this water will meet our various needs, and require a stable supply for both research and consumption.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of items with limited supplies.
High-quality items will earn a higher score.

missions.name: Survey Ferrofluid
missions.text: On a star as gravitationally unstable as Oizys, what goes up does not necessarily come down. As a result, it becomes increasingly difficult to transport and store liquids such as fuel, lubricants, and sealants. To solve this conundrum, we have begun employing magnetically reactive ferrofluid. It is a vital resource for the maintenance of the initiative's precision machinery, and thus we implore our members to contribute as many samples as possible.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of items with limited supplies.
High-quality items will earn a higher score.

missions.name: Quakeproof Materials
missions.text: Oizys's gravitational fluctuations occasionally result in meteorological and seismic phenomena, such as powerful wind gusts or minor earthquakes. Although the tremors may not be felt by the average researcher or Loporrit, they are no less dangerous than the windstorms, and could inflict long-term damage on our infrastructure if left unchecked. To combat the elements, we seek sturdy-yet-pliable construction materials for Terra Firma, that we might stave off any potential wear and tear.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of items with limited supplies.
High-quality items will earn a higher score.

missions.name: Recycled Fuel Research I
missions.text: Presently, our main method of transporting supplies to and from Etheirys is via the *Galactic Way*. The crew has put much time and effort into these endeavors, but they are not without their fair share of troubles, and schedule delays do occur from time to time. In light of these circumstances, we must put forth every effort to conserve resources, and Mumukko has proposed we all do our part to repurpose used materials into fuels and fertilizers.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of items with limited supplies.
High-quality items will earn a higher score.

missions.name: Water Supply Preservation
missions.text: The procurement of potable water is paramount to the initiative's─and, indeed, mankind's─survival. While we expected few water sources on Oizys's desolate landscape, its naturally occurring gravitational anomalies have presented us with a pleasant surprise: the discovery of a floating, spherical water source. Though its contents must be cleansed of some impurities, we believe that this water will meet our various needs, and require a stable supply for both research and consumption.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of items with limited supplies.
High-quality items will earn a higher score.

missions.name: Precision Instrument Ferrofluid
missions.text: On a star as gravitationally unstable as Oizys, what goes up does not necessarily come down. As a result, it becomes increasingly difficult to transport and store liquids such as fuel, lubricants, and sealants. To solve this conundrum, we have begun employing magnetically reactive ferrofluid. It is a vital resource for the maintenance of the initiative's precision machinery, and thus we implore our members to contribute as many samples as possible.

missions.name: High-quality Foodstuffs I
missions.text: As ever, luxury imports from Etheirys are few and far between. Due to our meager supply on Oizys, celebratory wines and sweetmeats are strictly rationed─even when there is legitimate cause to celebrate! missions.name: High-quality Foodstuffs II
missions.text: Initiative members have expressed interest in distributing fruit to better satiate and satisfy our hardworking contributors. Unfortunately, Oizys's hostile climes are unsuitable for cultivating orchards, and the amount of fresh foodstuffs we can import is extremely limited. To counter this, we plan to research natural additives for more effective flavor preservation and develop high-quality dried fruit in the process. We welcome the expertise of seasoned culinarians and nutritionists to expedite our efforts.

missions.name: EX: Archon Loaf Improvement Plan
missions.text: Although exceedingly rare, there are individuals who will experience feelings of euphoria during perceived times of strife. Perhaps unsurprisingly, these...optimistic individuals do exist among our members, and they regularly attempt to discover silver linings in adversity. In some extreme cases, these folk even challenge themselves to enhance their rations of Archon loaf─infamous for its abysmal flavor─by slathering it with various condiments. We entreat all culinary experts to contribute to their cause by delivering them unbridled happiness in the form of new condiments.

objectives.text:
Craft collectables with limited time and supplies and achieve the target score.
Collectability will be scored.

missions.name: EX: Refined Yeast Research
missions.text: Many among us have asked, “Is it possible to concoct an alcoholic beverage with Oizys's natural flora?” As if in answer to our fervent curiosity, our best and brightest have approved the use of our initiative-developed lunar yeast to find out. However, as its name implies, the yeast was initially developed for use in Sinus Ardorum, and so it falls to us to adapt it for Oizys's environs. We encourage all prospective cultivators to pitch in and aid the development of a new, gravity-resistant strain.

objectives.text:
Craft collectables with limited supplies and achieve the target score.
Collectability will be scored.

missions.name: EX: Experimental Fermentation
missions.text: Our long-term experimental cultivation efforts have been rewarded, and we have managed to harvest several varieties of vegetables and legumes on Oizys. Whether our palates can tolerate them, however, remains to be seen. To better answer this question, we are currently enlisting experts in the culinary and medical sciences who can analyze the crops' nutritional properties and process them into palatable products─successful outcomes would be a major leap forward for the initiative.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of collectables with limited supplies.
Collectability will be scored.

missions.name: EX: Outskirts Supply Improvements
missions.text: To ensure that no researcher goes without a hot meal, we are currently devising self-heating box lunches for those stationed in more remote locations across Oizys. In doing so, we hope to prevent further incidents involving researchers “accidentally” burning their Archon loaf to a crisp with fire magicks, and we encourage any culinarily minded artisans to join us in development.

objectives.text:
Craft items without failing once.
High-quality items will earn a higher score.

missions.name: EX+: Terminal Restoration Supplies
missions.text: The Voyagers' ruins contain various crystalline terminals that were once operated by large streams of aether. However, the passage of time has rendered the terminals' functions─and many of its internal mechanisms─inefficient. To restore their original functionalities, we must first ensure the crystals can properly absorb aether, which will require coating them in a healthy supply of aetheric stimulants and amplifiers. This, of course, is where our contributors come in, and those who can repurpose our existing stock of alchemical supplies for this task will be greatly rewarded.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of collectables with limited supplies.
Collectability will be scored.

missions.name: EX+: Excavation Materials
missions.text: Due to eras of tectonic activity, a wealth of ancient objects in the Voyagers' ruins are entombed deep within the bedrock. Were we simply unearthing resources, we would have no qualms about utilizing our machinery to excavate them. Doing so in the ruins, however, would risk damaging invaluable relics, so we shall require a more alchemical approach to overcome these stony obstacles. As this task may involve the creation of potent─and highly corrosive─concoctions, we recommend it only to artisans with ample experience handling dangerous materials.

objectives.text:
Craft collectables with limited time and supplies and achieve the target score.
Collectability will be scored.

missions.name: EX+: Cosmic Tool Enhancement I
missions.text: As part of our continued cosmic tool development project, our experts are currently redoubling their efforts to manufacture materials from Oizys-sourced resources. Due to the rarity of these resources and the difficulty involved in processing them, however, we have chosen to recruit only a handful of talented contributors to the cause. We will issue a specialized device to assist artisans, but be warned that it has a limited charge.

missions.text: Auxesia boasts an abundance of unique flora─each and every species an invaluable resource. missions.name: Reinforced Construction Materials
missions.text: Though ages have passed since the Voyagers' disappearance from their city, their architecture remains flawless and free of weathering. We believe our predecessors may have applied a magicked treatment on the materials used in these structures─one that blends hardier resources like metal and glass into their lumber. Our researchers are keen to emulate these feats of engineering, and beseech all able artisans to submit their own experimental samples based on our findings.

missions.name: Ruin Restoration Supplies

To counter this, we mean to employ a resin-based substitute with similar properties, but spreading it throughout the city regularly will require a stable supply from our contributors.

These events appear to accelerate the deterioration of foreign metals, and the effect is worryingly pronounced in areas removed from the rainbow crystal. In light of this, we wish to treat metals for aether resistance prior to use─unglamorous work, but critical to our success nonetheless.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of items with limited supplies.
High-quality items will earn a higher score.

missions.name: Heavy Machinery Components III
missions.text: While we have been employing new machinery and equipment on Auxesia to great effect, a shortage of replacement parts is all it takes to throw a cosmic wrench in our productivity. To ensure that our work continues hoppingly, we seek to bolster our stockpiles with those components that are in demand at work sites. Your contributions underpin our ongoing exploratory progress, and we ask that you spare no effort.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of collectables with limited supplies.
Collectability will be scored.

missions.name: Additional Forestry Implements
missions.text: As the restoration of the city's systems progresses, the magic-based control of vegetation has shown improved capacity, and we expect it will soon effectively keep noxious species in check. Yet though such plants may cause harm, total eradication is not an option, for they are a part of the ecosystem. An appropriate degree of hands-on management is the key, to which end we seek to build up a store of forestry implements.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of items with limited supplies.
High-quality items will earn a higher score, and collectability will be scored.

missions.name: Additional Exploration Provisions
missions.text: While we have identified magical passageways in structures like the Sprouting Towerling, these routes appear to be traversable only by the Voyagers. As we did not ship in sufficient materials, however, we ask our artisans to produce the shortfall while bearing the star's unique environmental conditions in mind.

missions.name: Aetheric Gauge Development I
missions.text: When investigating Voyager structures, it is critical to identify the invisible flow of aether, otherwise we risk inadvertently causing damage to ancient relics. missions.name: High-durability Heavy Machinery Parts
missions.text: Our newly deployed logging machina are powerful and effective at their tasks, but by the same token, they undergo extreme wear and require frequent, time-consuming servicing. This has resulted in low utilization rates, and the growing calls for harder-wearing components come as no surprise. We ask our artisans to employ their skills to produce durable replacement parts that can withstand rigorous use.

missions.name: EX: High-durability Wire
missions.text: Due to the dramatic terrain of the exploration site, the winches fitted on our new machina are nothing short of indispensable for transporting equipment and other heavy items. However, Auxesia's unusual environment is extremely harsh on the metal of the cables, causing premature degradation. It would be a disaster if a cable were to snap at the wrong moment, and we wish to build up a stockpile so as to ensure timely servicing.

objectives.text:

missions.name: EX: Environmental Maintenance Equipment
missions.text: As we explore this lush planet, we must be mindful of our impact on the environment. The exhaust fumes emitted by ceruleum engines, for instance, may have an adverse effect on plant life. While lasting harm has yet to be observed, in order to minimize the risk, we have decided to introduce filtering exhaust systems. Their development will require great skill, but we have utmost confidence in our artisans.

objectives.text:

missions.name: EX+: Voyager Relic Restoration
missions.text: The Voyagers left behind many of their vehicles throughout the city, notable among them the Timberdrone, a flying variety whose potential uses we are exploring. In order to employ them in the initiative, we call upon our artisans to provide the specified components.

To ensure that our work continues hoppingly, we seek to bolster our stockpiles with those components that are in demand at work sites. Your contributions underpin our ongoing exploratory progress, and we ask that you spare no effort.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of collectables with limited supplies.
Collectability will be scored.

missions.name: Additional Forestry Implements
missions.text: As the restoration of the city's systems progresses, the magic-based control of vegetation has shown improved capacity, and we expect it will soon effectively keep noxious species in check. Yet though such plants may cause harm, total eradication is not an option, for they are a part of the ecosystem. An appropriate degree of hands-on management is the key, to which end we seek to build up a store of forestry implements.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of items with limited supplies.

missions.name: Additional Exploration Provisions
missions.text: While we have identified magical passageways in structures like the Sprouting Towerling, these routes appear to be traversable only by the Voyagers. If we are to reach the tower's upper sections, we must do so the old-fashioned way and erect scaffolding. As we did not ship in sufficient materials, however, we ask our artisans to produce the shortfall while bearing the star's unique environmental conditions in mind.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of items with limited supplies.

missions.name: Improved Alloy Ingot Resupply
missions.text: While we were not expecting the forest isles of Auxesia to yield minerals in significant quantities, preliminary investigations have happily confirmed the presence of a variety of metals suitable for producing alloys that meet the initiative's stringent standards. As part of our endeavor to increase self-sufficiency on the star, we call upon our capable artisans to prepare ingots on-site.

objectives.text:

High-quality items will earn a higher score.

missions.name: Aether Resistance Treatment (Platinum)
missions.text: Weather phenomena characterized by unusual aetheric turbulence have been observed on Auxesia, not least of all floracanes. These events appear to accelerate the deterioration of foreign metals, and the effect is worryingly pronounced in areas removed from the rainbow crystal. In light of this, we wish to treat metals for aether resistance prior to use─unglamorous work, but critical to our success nonetheless.

missions.name: Aetheric Gauge Development I
missions.text: When investigating Voyager structures, it is critical to identify the invisible flow of aether, otherwise we risk inadvertently causing damage to ancient relics. To that end, we wish to develop a portable aetheric gauge which will be distributed to our researchers on the front lines of exploration. missions.name: High-durability Heavy Machinery Parts
missions.text: Our newly deployed logging machina are powerful and effective at their tasks, but by the same token, they undergo extreme wear and require frequent, time-consuming servicing. This has resulted in low utilization rates, and the growing calls for harder-wearing components come as no surprise. We ask our artisans to employ their skills to produce durable replacement parts that can withstand rigorous use.

missions.name: EX: High-durability Wire
missions.text: Due to the dramatic terrain of the exploration site, the winches fitted on our new machina are nothing short of indispensable for transporting equipment and other heavy items. However, Auxesia's unusual environment is extremely harsh on the metal of the cables, causing premature degradation. It would be a disaster if a cable were to snap at the wrong moment, and we wish to build up a stockpile so as to ensure timely servicing.

missions.name: EX: Environmental Maintenance Equipment
missions.text: As we explore this lush planet, we must be mindful of our impact on the environment. The exhaust fumes emitted by ceruleum engines, for instance, may have an adverse effect on plant life. While lasting harm has yet to be observed, in order to minimize the risk, we have decided to introduce filtering exhaust systems. Their development will require great skill, but we have utmost confidence in our artisans.

missions.name: EX+: Voyager Relic Restoration
missions.text: The Voyagers left behind many of their vehicles throughout the city, notable among them the Timberdrone, a flying variety whose potential uses we are exploring. While the units appear to have been magically propelled, their inner construction is relatively simple, and it should be possible to restore them with our technology. In order to employ them in the initiative, we call upon our artisans to provide the specified components.

missions.name: Multi-purpose Rope
missions.text: Auxesia boasts an abundance of unique flora─each and every species an invaluable resource. Some of the star's native plant fibers, for example, can be woven into highly sought-after ropes. However, before we can distribute these products, the initiative must establish safety standards to prevent potential injury. In order to meet demand and decide upon said standards, we require a surplus of quality handcrafted ropes based on those manufactured at our previous destinations.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of items with limited supplies.
High-quality items will earn a higher score.

missions.name: Reinforced Construction Materials
missions.text: Though ages have passed since the Voyagers' disappearance from their city, their architecture remains flawless and free of weathering. We believe our predecessors may have applied a magicked treatment on the materials used in these structures─one that blends hardier resources like metal and glass into their lumber. Our researchers are keen to emulate these feats of engineering, and beseech all able artisans to submit their own experimental samples based on our findings.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of items with limited supplies.
High-quality items will earn a higher score.

missions.name: Ruin Restoration Supplies
missions.text: Aether circulation was once viewed with great importance in the Voyagers' city. As such, we have utilized aetheric stimulants to quicken our own restoration efforts across the region. Alas, these stimulants have one drawback: they are quickly washed away by the star's natural humidity. To counter this, we mean to employ a resin-based substitute with similar properties, but spreading it throughout the city regularly will require a stable supply from our contributors.

objectives.text:
Craft the specified number of items with limited supplies.

missions.name: Transport Supply Samples I
missions.text: Preliminary tests have revealed that Auxesian plant life is especially susceptible to changes in humidity and temperature, and will wither away if not properly preserved. We petition the aid of deft and eager volunteers willing to enhance the freight units' capabilities and push our technology to the pinnacle of its potential.

missions.name: Botanic Supplies
missions.text: A sweeping study of the region's flora has revealed the possibility that the city's diverse plant life was, in fact, systematically organized in every district. In pursuit of more concrete answers, the research team has opted to assemble miniature gardens, that they might study certain species' symbiotic relationships and environmental impacts on a smaller scale. Naturally, manufacturing the gardens will require sufficient time and resources, and all botanical contributions to this project are welcome as we deepen our understanding of Voyager society.

missions.name: Habitation Furniture Renewal
missions.text: Many of our researchers upend their lives across the sea of stars and into new habitation modules each time we set course for a new destination. The wear and tear on their furnishings and belongings is inevitable after prolonged use, and many items that were brought in brand-new to Sinus Ardorum have seen better days upon their arrival to Auxesia. As it is our duty to ensure these dedicated workers have their creature comforts met and maintained, we ask all available artisans to aid us in the manufacture of new and improved furnishings.

missions.name: EX: Auxesian Fuel Development
missions.text: In a fortuitous development, we have discovered resin-rich fatwood resources on Auxesia, similar in quality to that of Oizys. When one considers the limited ceruleum we can transport from star to star, this discovery is a boon to all who yearn for a fuel supply closer to home. The key to combustible success, then, will be the creation of an accessible and environmentally friendly fuel with these resources, and we implore our contributors to lend their expertise to the development process. As this star is more...flammable than most, we plan to train users in the fuel's potential risks and inform them that it is meant primarily for short-term use.

They have requested all able procurers to supply us with the materials to accommodate their needs, such as resins and fibers.

missions.name: Enhanced Rope
missions.text: Auxesia boasts an abundance of unique flora─each and every species an invaluable resource. Some of the star's native plant fibers, for example, can be woven into highly sought-after ropes. However, before we can distribute these products, the initiative must establish safety standards to prevent potential injury. In order to meet demand and decide upon said standards, we require a surplus of quality handcrafted ropes based on those manufactured at our previous destinations.

missions.name: Reinforced Materials Advanced Processing
missions.text: Though ages have passed since the Voyagers' disappearance from their city, their architecture remains flawless and free of weathering. We believe our predecessors may have applied a magicked treatment on the materials used in these structures─one that blends hardier resources like metal and glass into their lumber. Our researchers are keen to emulate these feats of engineering, and beseech all able artisans to submit their own experimental samples based on our findings.

missions.name: Advanced Restoration Supplies
missions.text: Aether circulation was once viewed with great importance in the Voyagers' city. As such, we have utilized aetheric stimulants to quicken our own restoration efforts across the region. Alas, these stimulants have one drawback: they are quickly washed away by the star's natural humidity. To counter this, we mean to employ a resin-based substitute with similar properties, but spreading it throughout the city regularly will require a stable supply from our contributors.

missions.name: Transport Supply Overhaul
missions.text: Preliminary tests have revealed that Auxesian plant life is especially susceptible to changes in humidity and temperature, and will wither away if not properly preserved. As a result, improvements to our freight transport systems will be necessary if we wish to ship harvested specimens safely to Etheirys. We petition the aid of deft and eager volunteers willing to enhance the freight units' capabilities and push our technology to the pinnacle of its potential.

missions.name: Weatherproof Material Development I
missions.text: If you have spent a considerable amount of time on Auxesia, then you are doubtless familiar with the auroral flares that occur in its atmosphere. According to initiative skywatchers, these flares are not, in fact, natural─they are intentional phenomena, devised by the Voyagers for the acceleration of plant growth within the city. While the myriad colors and lights are a feast for the eyes, auroral flares may pose great risk to our delicate machinery. To counteract this, we intend to develop a unique variety of parasol that can shield these fragile instruments from the aurora's rays.

missions.name: Botanic Supplies
missions.text: A sweeping study of the region's flora has revealed the possibility that the city's diverse plant life was, in fact, systematically organized in every district. In pursuit of more concrete answers, the research team has opted to assemble miniature gardens, that they might study certain species' symbiotic relationships and environmental impacts on a smaller scale. missions.name: Habitation Furniture Renewal
missions.text: Many of our researchers upend their lives across the sea of stars and into new habitation modules each time we set course for a new destination. The wear and tear on their furnishings and belongings is inevitable after prolonged use, and many items that were brought in brand-new to Sinus Ardorum have seen better days upon their arrival to Auxesia. As it is our duty to ensure these dedicated workers have their creature comforts met and maintained, we ask all available artisans to aid us in the manufacture of new and improved furnishings.

missions.name: EX: Auxesian Fuel Development
missions.text: In a fortuitous development, we have discovered resin-rich fatwood resources on Auxesia, similar in quality to that of Oizys. When one considers the limited ceruleum we can transport from star to star, this discovery is a boon to all who yearn for a fuel supply closer to home. The key to combustible success, then, will be the creation of an accessible and environmentally friendly fuel with these resources, and we implore our contributors to lend their expertise to the development process. As this star is more...flammable than most, we plan to train users in the fuel's potential risks and inform them that it is meant primarily for short-term use.

missions.name: EX+: Voyager Resource Research
missions.text: The flow of aether was of paramount importance in Voyager society, which prided itself on its sophisticated magicks. In fact, a scan of the city's core infrastructure has revealed intricate webs of catalysts with varying aetheric conductivity, including three-dimensional arcane geometries within some structures. To more thoroughly ascertain the ins and outs of this technology, the research team plans to build miniature versions of these structures for experimentation. They have requested all able procurers to supply us with the materials to accommodate their needs, such as resins and fibers.

missions.name: Mineral Resource Procurement
missions.text: Certain rare plants on Auxesia reinforce their fibers with metals, making them a valuable resource in the verdant metropolis. missions.name: Long-life Potables
missions.text: The abundant plant life on Auxesia suggests ample water resources. Indeed, we have uncovered plentiful wellsprings and suspect the lowlands to contain rivers and wetlands. Alas, water may be everywhere, but not a drop to drink. In its natural state, Auxesian water contains elements that are harmful when ingested by thirsty members of the initiative. It is imperative that we purify and sterilize a robust stockpile of usable water.

missions.name: Experimental Loporrit Enrichment
missions.text: For time immemorial, we Loporrits have needed nothing more than a nibble on a carrot to revitalize and sustain ourselves. Now, through the Cosmic Exploration Initiative, we have experienced firstpaw the myriad cuisines enjoyed by the people of Etheirys. Should we not likewise explore the untapped potential of the humble carrot? In an effort to provide our Loporrit contributors in the field with a convenient and satisfying snack, we turn first to the development of carrot-flavored pellets.

missions.text: Auxesian architecture seems to rely heavily on incorporating plant life, which means we must be especially vigilant that our activities do not have any adverse environmental effects. missions.name: EX: Launch Party Liquor
missions.text: With work on Auxesia progressing apace, some teams are planning a celebration of our efforts thus far. It has come to our attention that several contributors─who have been known to enjoy a drink─are planning to commemorate the occasion by brewing a spirit from Auxesian flora, before sending the completed product to Etheirys. Connoisseurs from across Etheirys will no doubt flock to buy the liquor from a distant star, and we cannot leave this matter to amateurs. Expert artisans are called upon to create the finest vintage, befitting the initiative's name!

missions.name: EX+: Periphery Provisions
missions.text: Contributors working at isolated outposts on Oizys heaped praise on our self-heating lunches, and there is a similarly high level of demand on Auxesia. To protect the star from unintended fires─and the stomachs of our contributors from spoiled food─we are requesting the cooperation of experts in both fields. Rest assured, quality control will be *rigorously* conducted.

missions.text: We have confirmed the existence of invasive lunar fungi on the Scrambling Ways.
